data.one_liner: A customizable toggle switch widget that maintains selection state and supports icons, text, and custom widgets.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable toggle switch widget for Flutter applications. It supports multiple switches, icons, custom text styles, gradients, vertical layouts, and state maintenance out-of-the-box.
use_when: You need a multi-state or binary toggle switch UI component.
You want to customize colors, icons, borders, and animations for a switch.
You need to handle selection state changes with an optional cancellation callback.
avoid_when: You are looking for a standard Material Switch widget (use Flutter's built-in Switch instead).
You need complex form validation integration (though it can be used inside forms).
strengths: Highly customizable with icons, text, custom widgets, and gradients.
Supports vertical orientation and RTL text directions.
Maintains selection state easily with callbacks and cancel toggle support.
weaknesses: Limited to toggle switch UI use cases.
No built-in form field controller integration documented.
